title: 2012 Upper Deck #72 Cody Johnson Texas Longhorns Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2012 Upper Deck trading card features Cody Johnson, a rookie player from the Texas Longhorns football team. The card is part of the 2012 Upper Deck set and has a card number of 72. It is a sports trading card that is perfect for any football fan, especially those who support the NFL league.

The card is manufactured by Upper Deck and does not include an autograph from the player. It is a great addition to any collection of sports trading cards and is sure to impress fans of the Texas Longhorns. Don't miss out on the chance to own this unique piece of sports memorabilia.
